idea-plugin.name: libSQL / Turso
idea-plugin.description:
libSQL / Turso Database Driver for DataGrip

Native JDBC driver that connects DataGrip to libSQL and Turso databases via the HTTP pipeline API. No external dependencies required — just install and connect.

Features

  • Full schema introspection — tables, columns, primary keys, indexes, and foreign keys appear in the database tree
  • Proper query lifecycle — no hanging spinners (fixes the DBeaver driver issue)
  • SQLite dialect — full SQL completion and syntax highlighting
  • Turso Cloud ready — JWT auth token support, connects to any Turso database
  • Zero config — auto-registers in DataGrip's driver list on install

Getting Started

  1. Install this plugin and restart DataGrip
  2. Add a new Data Source → select libSQL / Turso
  3. Enter your Turso database host (e.g. my-db.turso.io)
  4. Go to the Advanced tab → set authToken to your Turso JWT token
  5. Test Connection

Supported Databases

  • Turso Cloud databases
  • Self-hosted libSQL servers (sqld)
  • Local libSQL instances
